hipaaString: So what makes APP_NAME HIPAA Compliant? It is important to note that there is no definitive guidelines or certifications that are officially recognized to make a product “HIPAA Secure”. Rather HIPAA simply demands compliance with the general rules within it specifically the Security Rule, the Privacy Rule and the Breach Notification Rule. APP_NAME supports HIPAA compliance (within the scope of the Business Associate Agreement) but ultimately complying with HIPAA is a shared responsibility between the customer and APP_NAME.  That said, there are a number of factors that go into making APP_NAME a HIPAA compliant form of communication that are both logistical and technological in nature:Logistics By using the APP_NAME applications, an automatic BAA is put in place. Using APP_NAME as your secure texting solution segregates communication containing PHI from your other communication platforms (SMS texting, email, etc.). APP_NAME was designed specifically for healthcare, so we have built the service with your workflows in mind.  We give you the tools to administer users and their access, control who should be notified of new messages, and manage your patient population. Our staff has completed HIPAA training — we treat your data with respect and care. Technological Data is encrypted when in transit. APP_NAME employs TLS RSA with ARIA-256-CBC/SHA-384 for Message Delivery and AES-256 for web service callouts. Data is encrypted when at rest.  APP_NAME’s hardware is hosted on the East Coast of the United States by Amazon utilizing their EC2 HIPAA compliant service and encrypted using AES-256.  APP_NAME and Amazon have an executed BAA in place. Account management can be handled by client-side Admins and/or by APP_NAME Support.  Ability to access and level of access can be managed per user with all users needing unique usernames and passwords. Conclusion APP_NAME is a secure communication platform that can be used to text with patients and colleagues without concern of a HIPAA violation. We have a HiTrust Assessment ensuring our information/network security approach complies with all HIPAA and NIST standards. Have more questions? Feel free to email us: SUPPORT_EMAIL
